summary: Verified the isolated Come In backup preview and backend source without modifying the active app. Preview returned HTTP 200, rendered branding and required home sections, and location/search/shops interactions navigated successfully.
action_items: Keep the backup isolated until explicit approval is provided to reconcile it with the active CRA/FastAPI project.
Provide intended backup environment configuration before enabling persistence or external integrations.
critical_code_review_comments: Backup backend requires MONGO_URL and DB_NAME from the environment at import time; this is correct for protected configuration, but no backup .env is included.
seed_data_creation: None. No production or backup data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated isolated preview at http://127.0.0.1:3001: brand-logo, location selector/modal/save, search navigation, shops card/navigation, eight category cards, catalog sections, and bottom navigation were present. Backup server.py compiled and imported when active /app/backend/.env values were exported; routes were GET /api/, POST /api/status, GET /api/status. No backup .env files were present. A test-side page.evaluate syntax error occurred after the functional checks and is not an application issue.
rca of the issue: No application defect reproduced. Direct backup backend import without environment variables raises KeyError for MONGO_URL by design; loading the protected active backend environment resolves it without copying secrets into the backup.
